R-30: Compare two pescatarian diets for eating healthier.
Goal: Compare two pescatarian diets for eating healthier.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-30/
STEP 2: Click "Accept all"
STEP 3: Click "See all diets"
STEP 4: Choose "Pescatarian" in "Diet type"
STEP 5: Check "Add Harbor Pescatarian Plan to compare"
STEP 6: Check "Add Pescatarian Mediterranean Plan to compare"
STEP 7: Click "Compare selected (2)"
STEP 8: Verify "Comparing 2 pescatarian diets" is visible

args.label: Add Harbor Pescatarian Plan to compare

steps.note: Select the Harbor plan for comparison.

args.label: Add Pescatarian Mediterranean Plan to compare

steps.note: Select the Mediterranean plan for comparison.
Verify the comparison shows two pescatarian diets.

reasoning: This test checks that two pescatarian diet plans can be selected and compared for healthier eating. The plan follows the specified flow and verifies the comparison heading confirms two pescatarian diets.
